sheets.title: PATIO PLAN — NEW WORK, DETAILS, CONTROLS, & SCHEDULE
sheets.reading_notes: Shows patio plan at 1/4"=1'-0" with three suspended gas-fired infrared tube unit heaters (UH-1, UH-2, UH-3) located along the patio area adjacent to Commerce Street. Natural gas piping runs from existing 5 PSIG supply above ceiling; includes gas regulator, emergency gas shut-off valve (EGSOV), and ball valves. Y-connections shown for gas branch takeoffs. Existing patio seating fence shown as context. Gas Connection Diagram (no scale) shows unvented pressure regulator (5 PSIG to 11 WC), 6" deep dirt leg, 24" flexible hose, ball valve, and gas cock arrangement. Controls section specifies manual on/off operation; zone setpoint adjustable by Twist staff. Emergency shut-off sequence: wall switch activation closes gas valve via 24V/120V relay and transformer. GAS FIRED INFRARED UNIT HEATER SCHEDULE: Mark UH-1 through UH-3, Input 35 MBH high / 25 MBH low, Bottom edge of heater 8"-11" AFF, Gas type Natural, Burner pressure 3.5" WC, Supply pressure minimum 5" WC, Supply pressure maximum 14" WC, Electrical service 120V/1ph/1.2A. Note 1: Selection based on SunStar Eclipse SIR .35 Series. Note 2: Provide with mounting bracket, relay kit, and draft inducer. Construction notes include: mounting height 10'5" AFF from bottom of heater, existing 5 PSIG piping above ceiling, EGSOV at 48" AFF, 6" dirt leg required, extend vent cap per M-501, all louvers static type sealed from building interior, Type B vent support at each column and on storefront, Type B vent manifold at 9'11".

sheets.title: PATIO PLAN — DETAIL
sheets.reading_notes: Unit Heater Section (no scale) shows tube heater suspended below 2nd floor slab with architectural panel, vent cap, and Type B vent. Clearances: 1'0" horizontal to interior wall, 4'9" vertical to floor, 4'0" to architectural panel above. Mounting & Draft Inducer Detail (no scale) shows suspension chain hardware, speed clip, tube flange, reflector (side view), and draft inducer assembly components — flue restrictor plate, tube flange (draft inducer), 1/4-20 locknuts, control box, access panel, tube flange gaskets, tube flange (control). Standard commercial tube heater installation detail sheet; no project-specific area dimensions.

sheets.title: PATIO ELECTRICAL PLAN — NEW WORK
sheets.reading_notes: Shows same patio plan at 1/4"=1'-0" with electrical work. Demolition note: disconnect and remove existing ceiling fan and ceiling fan switch; refurbish electrical circuit to power new equipment. Construction notes: (1) exhauster junction box and control box; (2) extend existing circuit to accommodate heaters — relabel panel schedule upon completion; (3) coordinate with owner for switch location. Three unit heater designations (UH-1, UH-2, UH-3) shown with wiring runs. Existing Panel A referenced. Existing ceiling fan to be removed. Existing recessed lights (existing) shown as context. Legend: sprinklers, camera, unit heater designation, recessed lights (existing), 1" FMC with 2x#12 and 1x#12 ground THWN, 1" FMC with 2x#16 and 1x#16 ground (common) THWN, ceiling fan junction box (existing), three-position switch Part #40147010. Wiring is 120V single-phase per heater schedule.

sheets.title: PATIO ELECTRICAL PLAN — DETAILS
sheets.reading_notes: Manual Switch Connections diagram for Single Heater Operation Per Dual Manual Switch (no scale). Shows 120V circuit: Ground, Neutral, L1 Hot (120V) from fused disconnect switch with thermostat connection block. Each heater has: Lo/C/Hi exhauster junction box with 3 Core SJO Cable (extend for LTS installation), control box, and Low Fire / High Fire manual switches (field supplied). Note: Low Fire Switch MUST stay on during High Fire running. Wiring diagram enables two-stage (high/low) manual control of each tube heater independently. Confirms 120V single-phase supply.
